SUBJECTS_drawbridge_art.label: Drawbridge art
SUBJECTS_drawbridge_art.title: Drawbridge art — game art
SUBJECTS_drawbridge_art.lead_html: Drawbridge art, first pass (owner, 2026-10-20: “commission the art for the bridges so it will be ready for you by the time you need it.”). Timber and steel, matched to the suspension bridge beside each row. The lowered leaf reuses the suspension deck, so it is not here. Pick or reject per row; nothing is installed until you rule. ⚠ Two east views came out three-quarter instead of side/edge-on: timber winch and timber closed gate (flagged on their rows). Rows with no picture are renders still in the queue (the image service throttled us with 429s).
